create_retriever_subclass: create a subclass of Retriever that implements feed_data and run abstract methods
init_retriever_from_default_config: instantiate a Retriever subclass using from_default_config with a retriever name
init_retriever_from_config_file: instantiate a Retriever subclass using from_config_file with a JSON config file path
init_retriever_from_config_string: instantiate a Retriever subclass using from_config_string with a JSON config string
